# nullplatform_package_installation (Resource)

Installs a package at an NRN of the caller's organization: the organization's own row for that package, saying where its specification is usable (`visible_to`) and which revision new services there are born with (`default_revision_id`). Installing copies nothing — the specification, its actions and its artifacts stay the publisher's. A package published for every organization (`visible_to` `organization=*`) is usable only where it is installed; look it up with the `nullplatform_package` data source's `visible_at`. Publishing a new revision, or the publisher moving its own default, moves no installation: change `default_revision_id` here to move new services, and roll existing services out one by one. Destroying uninstalls; the API refuses while a live service born from the installation remains.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Find a package published for every organization, then install it in one
# account. New services there are born with the revision installed here.
data "nullplatform_package" "lambda" {
  visible_at = "organization=123:account=456"
  slug       = "scopes-lambda"
}

resource "nullplatform_package_installation" "lambda" {
  nrn                 = "organization=123:account=456"
  package_id          = data.nullplatform_package.lambda.id
  default_revision_id = data.nullplatform_package.lambda.revision_id

  # Optional: where inside the organization the specification is usable.
  # Defaults to [nrn].
  visible_to = ["organization=123:account=456:namespace=789"]
}

# Providers the package can use but the organization has not configured yet.
output "missing_optional_requirements" {
  value = nullplatform_package_installation.lambda.missing_optional_requirements
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `nrn` (String) Where the package is installed: an NRN of the caller's organization (an organization, account, namespace or application). Changing it installs again elsewhere.
- `package_id` (String) The package to install: one visible to the organization — published for every organization, or the organization's own. Changing it is another installation.

### Optional

- `default_revision_id` (String) The revision new services under `visible_to` are born with. When omitted, the package's default at install time is resolved and stored; the installation does not follow the package's default afterwards. Must belong to the package and not be deprecated. Changing it moves only new services.
- `visible_to` (List of String) Where inside the installing organization the package's specification is usable: these NRNs and everything below them. Defaults to `[nrn]`. Every entry must stay inside the installing organization.

### Read-Only

- `created_by` (String) Id of the user that installed the package.
- `default_version` (String) Semver of `default_revision_id`.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `missing_optional_requirements` (List of Object) Optional providers the package declares that the organization had not configured at `nrn` or above when it was installed. Reported once, at install; missing required providers refuse the install instead. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--missing_optional_requirements))
